tabs.label: Test strategy
tabs.intro: A one-page test strategy for the sample app's sign-in and second-step flows.

sections.title: Scope
items: In scope: registration, sign in, e-mailed code, authenticator app and passkey steps, backup codes, lockout, session handling.
Out of scope: load testing and third-party mail delivery.

sections.title: Objectives
items: Confirm each sign-in path works for valid users.
Confirm invalid, expired and reused credentials are rejected safely.
Confirm error messages are clear and do not leak account details.

sections.title: Test types
items: Basic security checks with a proxy tool

sections.title: Approach
items: Derive scenarios from the feature list, then test cases per scenario.
Prioritise sign in and code verification, then recovery and lockout.
Report every defect with steps, expected and actual results, and evidence.

sections.title: Entry and exit criteria
items: Entry: build deployed, sample accounts available, scenarios reviewed.
Exit: all planned cases executed, no open high-severity defects, regression cases passed.

sections.title: Tools
items: Browser developer tools, Postman, Burp Suite, SQL client for data checks, a spreadsheet or test-management sheet for cases.

sections.title: Risks
items: Time-limited codes make some cases timing sensitive.
Lockout cases change account state, so they need dedicated accounts.

sections.title: Deliverables
items: Scenario list, frontend and API test cases, defect reports, regression selection, a short test summary.
